acceptance: Wasm compiles and runs the full conformance corpus and all runnable examples without AIPO_COMPILE_WASM_UNSUPPORTED.
RegVM executes the full conformance corpus without fallback for language features; remaining fallback is limited to documented host services.
VM, RegVM, JS and Wasm agree on stdout, failures and diagnostics for the differential corpus.
Collection, string, math, conversion, async and failure-handling features are covered by Wasm/Reg tests.
Coverage and known limits are recorded in the backend matrix and progress panel.
Full workspace, MSRV 1.96, strict docs and site gates remain green.
constraints: No regression in Stack VM/JS semantics.
Do not hide unsupported constructs behind generic runtime faults.
Every new backend feature needs a conformance or differential test.
non_goals: Post-v1 product features beyond backend/VM parity.
objective: Close the language feature and backend parity gaps for Wasm and RegVM, with differential tests and no undocumented fallback or unsupported construct.
title: Wasm and RegVM parity completion
